clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Covers dimensions, quality and strength requirement of burnt clay jallies having perforations of ornamental designs. Note — Burnt clay jallies are suitable for providing a screen on Verandah, Construction of parapet or boundary walls, etc.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 2.2 Tolerances Dimensions Total Tolerance for 20 Jallies 190 mm 140 mm ± 80 mm 100 mm 90 mm ± 40 mm 50  mm

clauses.title: The thickness of any
clauses.text: 2.3. The thickness of any shell shall not be less than 10 mm and that of the web not less than 8 mm. The total void area of the jallies shall not eceed 40 percent.

clauses.title: Keys of bonding with
clauses.text: 2.4. Keys of bonding with mortar shall be 10 mm wide and 3 mm deep.

clauses.title: General Quality
clauses.text: 3. General Quality — Jallies shall be free from web or shell  cracks, flaws or nodules of free lime. Shall be uniform in colour and texture. In the case of wire-cut jallies, the cut faces shall be at right angles and parallel to each other and the edges of shell and webs shall be trimmed to a  smooth finish. The jallies shall not exhibit excessive warpage when placed between two parallel straight-edges. The maximum warpage permissible shall be 3 percent in any direction.

clauses.title: Average breaking load shall
clauses.text: 4.1. Average breaking load shall not be less than 12 N per mm width :

clauses.title: Average water absorption shall
clauses.text: 4.2. Average water absorption shall not be more than 15 percent

clauses.title: Efflorescence rating shall be
clauses.text: 4.3. Efflorescence rating shall be not more than "slight". Note — For methods of tests, refer to Appendices A to C of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 7556:1988 Specification for Burnt clay allies  (first revision) SUMMARY OF IS 7556 : 1988 BURNT CLAY  JALLIES (First Revision)
